description: This file contains unit tests for the ViewList class within the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing various functionalities like list view processing, preparation, display, and search form processing.

classes.name: ViewListTest
classes.description: A set of PHPUnit test cases for the ViewList class, covering method functionalities such as list view processing, preparation, search form handling, and display rendering.

methods.name: testlistViewProcess
methods.description: Tests the listViewProcess method to ensure it successfully renders HTML content.

methods.name: testViewList
methods.description: Tests the constructor of the ViewList class and its basic properties.

methods.name: testlistViewPrepare
methods.description: Tests the listViewPrepare method with and without REQUEST parameters to verify it outputs HTML and sets request variables.

methods.name: testprepareSearchForm
methods.description: Verifies the prepareSearchForm method initializes a SearchForm object with and without REQUEST parameters present.

methods.name: testprocessSearchForm
methods.description: Tests processSearchForm method's behavior with use_old_search flag set or unset, ensuring correct output.

methods.name: testpreDisplay
methods.description: Verifies that preDisplay initializes the lv attribute as a ListViewSmarty object.

methods.name: testdisplay
methods.description: Tests the display method's output with and without bean attribute set, verifying HTML output.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, including setting up a mock current user.
